title: Chapter 1207
text:
"This mission …"

Han Xiaoxin was shocked. It was a Grade S hidden mission, and a chain mission at that. The experience reward from the first round was already comparable to Old Manison's. The overall difficulty was probably through the roof.

In a situation where there was a lack of intelligence, the mission guide was one of the few reliable sources of information. The name of this mission was especially intriguing.

"In any case, this mysterious person took the initiative to contact me. He seems to have some special information in his hands, so I definitely have to meet him. As for the hunting team in the mission guide …"

Han Xiao's eyes flickered.

When he was chatting online, he found out that the Celestial Star Alliance's Superpower Security Department had issued a bounty for two people. The bounty was 300 million units of the common currency, and the name was different from the 'Enas' of the main universe.

His whereabouts had been hidden for the past few days, and he had not encountered any alarms or detection devices. He had been hiding on a desolate planet to open a base. Logically speaking, it should have been difficult for others to discover his location. However, the mission guide and the mysterious person's message seemed to conclude that the pursuers would definitely be able to find him.

Thinking of the strange concealment device left behind by the mysterious person, Han Xiao guessed that the pursuers might have a precise long-range positioning method, including but not limited to prophecies, technological means, Universal Treasures, and so on …

"The mysterious person sent this blueprint but did not explain in detail what methods the pursuers have. It feels more like a test …"

Han Xiao stroked his chin thoughtfully.

He definitely had to study this technology, but he did not plan to use it immediately. He wanted to see if he would definitely be found by the pursuers. If it was confirmed, he would then use this device to verify if this device really had a targeted concealment effect. As a Mechanic, he trusted the results of the experiment more.

On the other hand, Han Xiao also wanted to contact the pursuers and obtain more information from them. Of course, although he was confident in his own strength, he would still set up insurance measures to stabilize the situation.

Currently, the two of them were unregistered and did not even have an account in the galactic bank, let alone the common currency here. They had fallen from being rich in the universe to being extremely poor. Han Xiao could only collect resources himself. For the time being, he could not gather the materials to build a new King mechanical suit, so he could only use the spare King that he carried with him. Some of the "Thrones" had already been set up at different coordinates in the main universe to act as fixed-point teleportation devices. The other backup King mecha was complete and was used as a tool for positioning at any time.

Having been in the universe for so many years, and with Old Manison as his' role model ', Han Xiao was well aware of the principle of a cunning rabbit having three burrows. A few days ago, he had ordered a group of mechanical troops to disperse with different' Thrones' and find a suitable location to set up an escape route.

The biggest problem was not his personal safety but his Mech Legion. Because his secondary dimensional army box was frozen, he could only use traditional methods to transport his troops, which severely affected his mobility. If he teleported away, the Mech Legion would remain where it was and could not be retrieved.

Logically speaking, since there were no secondary dimensions here, all Mechanics should be the same. However, he found out on the internet that although there were five Super systems here, due to the lack of secondary dimensions, some of the class skills seemed to be slightly different from those in the main universe.

For example, the Beyond Grade A Mechanics here still had the ability to summon a Mech Legion on a large scale. It was just that he had never fought against them before, so he could not see the battle information. Thus, Han Xiao did not know how it worked.

"Just these technologies alone are already worth the price of the ticket."

Han Xiao was extremely excited.

The way he saw it, this was a huge material library with countless new technologies. There were also different development directions for the class skills. These were all extremely precious resources.

In his previous life, Manison had probably learned a lot of new skills when he came here, further improving his foundation.

But now, this rare learning opportunity had been snatched away by him.

"Rest in peace, Old Manison. I will learn well for you."

Han Xiao's face was solemn.

At this time, Kasuyi finally recovered from Han Xiao's' comforting blow '. Seeing this, Han Xiao explained the situation and his plan.

Kasuyi's face was filled with surprise. In the end, he could not help but ask, "You mean … we have to wait for the pursuers to come and negotiate, and we might have to fight them?"

"That's right. This is to obtain more information. Don't be scared by the number of Beyond Grade As here. I've checked the cases of the Supers Security Department over the years. Most of the time, there are only three to five Beyond Grade As in a team. They won't come with dozens or hundreds of people. The area they are responsible for is very large, and their manpower is limited. Plus, I've already arranged an escape route."

Han Xiao said.

Old Kasuyi was his only companion at the moment. It could be said that they depended on each other and could only advance and retreat together. Although he did not have unlimited mana, he was still a peak Beyond Grade A and would be a powerful help.

"… Alright, then don't disturb me during this time. I'll prepare a trump card and try to heavily injure a peak Beyond Grade A the moment we fight," Kasuyi said solemnly.

Han Xiao was shocked. He sized him up and said in surprise, "I didn't expect you to have such an ability."

Kasuyi rolled his eyes.

Who are you looking down on? At our level, who doesn't have one or two trump cards? When I was roaming the universe, your great-grandfather wasn't even born yet!

…

In the dark universe, a wormhole suddenly opened, and three hyperdrive streams of light shot out. They were three special spaceships belonging to the Supers Security Department, a special pursuit team led by three 'Supreme' Secretaries.

"The positioning star map of the headquarters shows that the two targets have been staying on the target planet and have not left for the past few days."

"We still don't know the intentions of these two people. Don't let your guard down."

Milton stood in front of the porthole, listening to the voice in the communication channel. His expression was serious, and his entire person exuded a serious aura.

He was the Secretary of the Fifth Division of the Supers Security Department and the temporary captain of this special pursuit team.

The establishment of a division was one Supreme Secretary, four Saint Body Deputy Secretaries, and a large number of middle-level officers. Milton brought two Deputy Secretaries with him this time, and the other two Secretaries had the same configuration. Therefore, there were three Supremes and six Saint Bodies in the team, making a total of nine people.

Due to the lack of data on the target's strength, in order to end the battle quickly, the Supers Security Department equipped the nine people with special combat suits, including mechanical suits, close-combat suits, long-range suits, and confinement devices, all of which were of gold quality. Relying on these special equipment, the members of the Supers Security Department had an innate advantage against experts of the same level.

The opponent was only two Supreme Beings, while he had a total of nine people on his side. With the support of equipment, Milton felt that this operation would be easy.

He looked at the wanted posters of Han Xiao and Kasuyi on the virtual screen and whispered to himself, "What era is it now?

There are still people who dare to openly violate the universe-level ban of the Celestial Star Alliance, trying to do whatever they want with strength. Do they still think it's the past? The good times have long passed … "

…

Time passed quickly, and another three days passed in the blink of an eye.

Han Xiao had been in seclusion studying the blueprint provided by the mysterious man. The difficulty of making it was not high, but the principle was quite difficult to understand. There were some parts that he did not understand, and he did not know what the effect would be when combined.

After a few days of research, there was no progress. Han Xiao felt that he might be lacking key theoretical knowledge or abilities, so he simply stopped his research and tried to make the device according to the blueprint. The result was very smooth. Although he did not understand the principle, it did not prevent him from using his mechanical manufacturing ability to copy the blueprint without any errors.

Ten palm-sized green-gold metal pieces lay quietly on the workbench. They looked quite smooth, but when Han Xiao used his fingers to trace them, he could feel the dense lines on them. Countless nano-scale energy circuits were engraved on the surface.

Han Xiao picked up a metal piece and played with it carefully. Traces of electric arcs jumped, and his perception went deep into the metal piece, feeling the structure inside.

"The manual says that as long as the concealment effect is activated, objects within a range will be able to escape tracking. The more energy input, the larger the range …"

Han Xiaoxin was a little doubtful. He knew the blueprints of many concealment devices, but he could not see the principle of how this thing worked.

Even the interface did not give a detailed introduction. It only called it a 'special concealment device', saying that it would only work under certain conditions, but it did not say what the conditions were.

Just as he was about to study it further, his expression suddenly changed, and he sensed something unexpected.

Some of the space detection buoys around this planet had been destroyed, and the enemy was approaching.

"They really found us …"

Han Xiao paused, narrowed his eyes, put away the ten concealment devices, and left the base with his mechanical army, coming to the surface.

Hu hu!

Not long after, three spaceships appeared outside the atmosphere. Nine figures descended from the sky and landed on the wasteland not far in front of Han Xiao, surrounding him in a fan-shaped circle. None of them hid their energy fluctuations.

Seeing this, Han Xiao's eyes flashed, showing an expected expression.

Nine Beyond Grade As, three of which were peak Beyond Grade As …

This was not a small lineup, and their overall combat strength was even higher than the level of the rescue battle of Hila. Furthermore, this group of people would not go easy like Kasuyi did back then. If they really fought, there would not be any shortcuts.

He also discovered that the equipment on this group of people seemed to be extraordinary, not like ordinary goods.

The two sides faced each other from a distance, sizing each other up, but neither side attacked immediately.

Milton looked around and asked casually, "Where's your partner?"

"Since you can come here, how can you not know where he is?" Han Xiao stood with his arms crossed.

In the past few days, he had specially taken some time to learn the galactic language on the Internet. Now, communication was no longer a problem.

Milton looked down at his feet, nodded, and said in a businesslike tone, "I advise you not to resist.

"I advise you not to have any thoughts of resistance. Obediently put on the Origin Energy Sealing Device and come with us. Explain your origins, abilities, and reasons for violating the ban. Conduct a public review and serve five to ten years in prison. After completing this, you can regain your freedom. The punishment is still very light, so there's no need to increase your crimes. "

Han Xiao did not comment and suddenly asked, "May I know your identities?"

"You don't know us?" Milton frowned. "I'm Milton, the Fifth Division Director of the Superpower Security Department. These two are my assistants …"

He briefly introduced the identities of the nine people and then asked about Han Xiao's identity.

"What are your names?"

"You can call me Black Star. As for my partner, you can call him Kasuzi …"

"Call me Void Overlord!"

As soon as he said that, Kasuyi appeared beside Han Xiao and corrected him with dissatisfaction.

"You can call me whatever you want." Milton did not care. He took out two mechanical devices similar to collars and threw them in front of the two of them. "Quickly put on the Origin Energy Confinement Device and come back with us."

Han Xiao pondered for a while and said, "I think we have a better choice.

My friend and I have been in seclusion and don't know about the so-called ban. We're not deliberately causing trouble. Maybe there's still room for negotiation? For example, if we're willing to join the Superpower Security Department, can you inform your superiors … "

In his opinion, he and Kasuyi did not commit any major crimes. With their strength, they should still be able to enjoy this treatment.

Milton, however, did not buy it at all.

He said in a deep voice, "I'm informing you now, not negotiating with you! If you have anything to say, come back with us! And regardless of whether what you said is true or not, don't think that you can escape punishment like this. Even if you're willing to join us, you still have to serve your sentence. Even if you're a Supreme, as long as the stain is not removed, we won't accept you! "

Hearing this, Han Xiao's eyebrows twitched slightly.

He was not saying this to beat around the bush. He did not intend to be restricted by the mission. Cooperating with the Celestial Star Alliance was not a bad choice. Furthermore, Kasuyi's mission was like looking for a needle in a haystack. If he could get the help of the Celestial Star Alliance, it would be much more convenient.

There were two ways to cooperate. One was to reveal his identity as an outsider, and the other was to pretend to be a local. Obviously, Han Xiao could not choose the former. Before things became clear, he would never reveal any information about the three Universal Civilizations. Otherwise, it would be bad if he attracted their attention. He would be no different from a traitor.

Therefore, Han Xiao could only choose to pretend to be a local and join the Superpower Security Department. Originally, he felt that with his and Kasuyi's strength, the other party had no reason to not accept them. The small violation of the ban could be written off. However, the strong people here did not seem to have much prestige. Two pinnacle Beyond Grade As had taken the initiative to offer themselves, yet they did not want them.

This should not be. There were nearly ten thousand Beyond Grade As here. This was an extremely strong force, but the advanced civilizations did not seem to have any plans to stabilize them. It should be known that the strong enjoyed higher privileges and better treatment. But now, it felt like they were treating everyone the same. Were they not afraid of intensifying conflicts?

Han Xiao could not bring the Origin Energy Restraining Device to the Superpower Security Department's headquarters. That would be tantamount to handing over the power of life and death to the other party.

"No room for discussion?"

Milton pointed at the two sets of Origin Energy Restraining Devices on the ground. Although he did not say anything, his meaning was obvious.

Boom!

At this moment, an extremely condensed and violent psychic energy suddenly shot out from the side. It was the trump card that Kasuyi had been holding back for a few days!

Boom!

Milton suddenly suffered a heavy blow. His eyeballs bulged, and blood burst out from his mouth and nose. His entire body was blasted away, turning into a meteor and disappearing into the distance.

Han Xiao turned his head and saw that Kasuyi's psychic energy was surging, and he had already rushed out. He glanced back in annoyance.

"What are you waiting for? Do it!"
